overview.heading: What is the SDG *Innovation* Summit 2026?
overview.text:
The SDG Innovation Summit Malaysia 2026 is a premier international youth summit designed to bring together 100 young leaders, innovators, students, entrepreneurs, professionals, researchers, and changemakers from around the world to explore innovative ideas, foster meaningful collaboration, and create sustainable impact in support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Following the success of our international summit in Bangkok, Thailand, the summit continues in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Through keynote addresses, high-level panel discussions, leadership workshops, innovation labs, strategic networking, and cultural exchange activities, delegates will gain valuable knowledge, practical skills, global perspectives, and meaningful international connections. Participants also compete for a $1,000 Seed Grant to support innovative projects and social impact initiatives, whether at the conceptual stage, in the pilot phase, under implementation or fully realized.

Delegates present innovative ideas aligned with four focus SDGs: SDG 4 Quality Education, SDG 5 Gender Equality, SDG 9 Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure, and SDG 13 Climate Action.

groups.title: Eligibility
items: Students, volunteers, graduates, change-makers, social entrepreneurs, and professionals at any stage of their careers.
Must be available to attend the summit in Kuala Lumpur from 19-22 Nov 2026

groups.title: Scholarship criteria
items: A strong personal statement of 250–300 words explaining why you are interested in joining the SDG Innovation Summit 2026.
Applicants should possess leadership skills, a passion for the SDGs, and a visionary mindset.
Volunteering or leadership experience preferred but not mandatory.
Applicants from all backgrounds and fields are welcome to apply.

items.name: UNU Global Health
items.text: The Global Youth Network (GYN) organizes the SDG Innovation Summit Malaysia, co-hosted by the United Nations University International Institute for Global Health, Malaysia. Participants will have an opportunity to engage with UNU Global Health representatives and UNU Young Leaders during the summit. The institute operates in Kuala Lumpur as a global research think tank focusing on health equity and sustainable development.

items.name: Asia Pacific University (APU)
items.text: Experience an exclusive institutional visit to Asia Pacific University (APU), one of Malaysia's leading universities. Explore its academic environment and global learning community while connecting with fellow international delegates. Delegates will also explore Petaling Street (Chinatown), GMBB KL, Petronas Twin Towers, KLCC Park and many other spots.

items.q: When will the selected applicants be announced?
items.a: The result will be announced on 16th October 2026.

items.q: How Can I Apply for Fully Funded and Partially Funded Slots?
items.a: To apply for a fully or partially funded scholarship, please complete the general application form. All submissions are reviewed by our independent, international selection panel, which ensures a transparent process for final scholarship decisions.

items.q: Can I Attend the SDG Innovation Summit If Not Selected for the Scholarship?
items.a: If you aren’t selected for a scholarship, you can still join us at the summit by choosing either the Self-Funded Package or the Forum Access Package. Regardless of your funding status, you will enjoy the same full experience and privileges as all other participants.

To help with your visa application, the GYN will provide an official invitation letter, proof of accommodation, and the program location. While we are happy to offer guidance throughout the process, please note that the final decision rests with the embassy, and we cannot guarantee visa approval.

items.q: What should I do if I do not have a passport at the time of application?
items.a: You can still apply! Simply upload a copy or enter the number of your National Identity Card (NIC), or any student ID in place of the passport details for now.

items.q: How can I pay my application fee?
items.a: You can securely pay the application fee using a debit or credit card, Google Pay through a trusted Stripe payment gateway.

Application fees are standard for many international conferences and youth programs. The fee supports our application, review, and selection process and helps us manage applications from participants worldwide. It does not guarantee selection.

items.q: Am I required to provide proof of English language proficiency?
items.a: No, English test scores (such as IELTS or TOEFL) are not required for this application.

items.q: Need Assistance or Want to Contact Us?
items.a: You can reach us via email at contact@thegyn.org

items.q: How will I find out about my selection and results?
items.a: All applicants will receive an email with their results. We will also post the final list of selected delegates on the GYN Facebook and Instagram pages. Follow us on Facebook and Instagram (facebook.com/thegyn.org, instagram.com/gyn_global)
